svg.title: Mind Map Studio: working with an AI assistant, without an API key
svg.desc: A looping animation in two scenes. 1: the three things you can ask for: expand adds more ideas to the brainstorm (append-only), convert turns the brainstorm into a structured mind map, and improve sharpens titles, grouping and notes in both. 2: Export, For AI… makes a packet with the convert intent. Your AI assistant uses the skill folder and checks its reply against the schemas folder. Importing the reply offers Put the map into Launch plan; the new map appears, and one Undo reverts it.

g.text: Sharper titles, grouping and notes in both
Pick what you want from the AI: expand, convert or improve.
Expand the brainstorm, convert it to a map, or improve both.
Any assistant that reads and writes files
No API key: the app never
Export ▾ → For AI… makes a packet: expand, convert or improve.
Your assistant follows skill/ and checks its reply against schemas/.
Import the reply: it goes back into the project, and one Undo reverts it.
An AI round trip, no API key
The app hands your AI assistant a file and takes the answer back.
